Shadow It Report Resource Get Report Transactions Export
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/shadowIT/applications/:entity/exportCsv

Export the Shadow IT Report (in CSV format) for the list of users or known locations identified with using the cloud applications specified in the request. This report includes information about each user who has interacted with the application or the known location from where the application is accessed, application category, application usage details, the number of transactions made, last accessed time, etc.

You can customize the report per your requirements by using various filters. To learn more, see About Application Information.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
entity
string
REQUIRED

Possible values: [USER, LOCATION]

Indicates whether the Shadow IT Report must be generated to retrieve the list of users who have interacted with a cloud application or the known locations where the cloud application is accessed

Default value: USER
APPLICATION/JSON
BODYREQUIRED

Information used to generate the Shadow IT Report for the list of users that have interacted with a specific or the known where the cloud application is accessed.

duration
string

(Required) Filters the data by using predefined timeframes.

Possible values: [LAST_1_DAYS, LAST_7_DAYS, LAST_15_DAYS, LAST_MONTH, LAST_QUARTER]

application
string[]

(Required) The cloud application for which user or location data must be retrieved.

Note: Only one cloud application can be specified at a time in this field.

order
object
downloadBytes
object[]
uploadBytes
object[]
dataConsumed
object[]
users
object[]
locations
object[]
departments
object[]
Responses
​
default

Successful Operation
